facts.name: Blazing Star
facts.notes: Tall purple spikes that open from the top down, loved by bees and butterflies. Grows from a corm and stays narrow.

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Wetland species list

companions.why: Combines with yellow flowers such as coreopsis and goldenrod, pink ones such as purple coneflower, prairie grasses and silver plants such as Stachys (lamb's ear).
